inv.desc_en:
VILLAVERDE MADRID - LOGISTICS WAREHOUSE

KNIGHT FRANK HAS BEEN EXCLUSIVELY MANDATED FOR THE COMMERCIALIZATION OF THIS LOGISTICS PARK.

Logistics park located in the first Crown of Madrid, in the Villaverde industrial estate, a historic industrial estate currently undergoing renovation and modernization.

Total available surface: 21,033 m²
It has conditioned offices

Access control and security

Flexible warehouse project with a total area of 21,033 m² and with capacity to rent from 2,000 m² and other combinations up to 21,033 m²
Free height of 11.70 meters
Maneuvering area: 32 meters
Total docks per module: 16 + 14 Van ramps
PCI Medium risk level 5
LED lighting system

Community fees: consult (not included in the indicated rent)

Availability: Q3 2024

Call us and we can offer you different alternatives that fit your needs.

Fees paid by the property.
